## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What are you trying to achieve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature you'd like. How should it behave?

## Fit with the product
Which part of [the positioning](../../docs/positioning.md) does this strengthen?

- [ ] The tenant as a first-class object (isolation, lifecycle, per-customer operations)
- [ ] State and vector memory in one engine
- [ ] Cost per active tenant (memory, density, hibernation)
- [ ] Self-hosted operability (single binary, operator UI)
- [ ] None of the above — explain below why it still belongs in DBX

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches did you consider? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Additional Context
Add any mockups, links, or examples that would help clarify the request.
